evals.name: exploration leaves workspace untouched
evals.prompt: Explore whether the project should add a single workflow skill named eval-review. Inspect relevant files and tell me whether it duplicates anything. Do not implement or save a proposal.
evals.expected_output: A concise, repository-grounded conclusion and change sketch only if justified; exploration must leave the project unchanged.

expectations.text: Explore leaves every project file unchanged.
Investigation identifies the skills as repository inputs.

evals.name: exploration recognizes single-item need
evals.prompt: A user wants to record a single missing requirement to list changes by status. Explore the right traceability approach, without writing files.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes this as a single requirement item, not a multi-artifact change; recommends tspec-write-item and makes no durable edits.

expectations.text: Single-item exploration leaves every project file unchanged.
Points a single-item need to the single-item authoring workflow.

evals.name: existing coverage does not force a change sketch
evals.prompt: The fixture already has a requirement that fully covers the requested feature of listing changes by status. Explore whether a new change is warranted, and do not write files.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes the existing requirement fully covers listing changes by status, reports that no new change is warranted, and does not modify the workspace.

expectations.text: Exploration of already-covered need makes no project edits.
Concludes that existing coverage removes the need for a new change.
